label: The reference inverter
subgoals: Size the reference inverter with nMOS width 1 and pMOS width gamma
Compute the reference input capacitance as one plus gamma
Require every gate's worst-case path to match the inverter's resistance

label: Series stacks get wider
subgoals: Multiply each series device's width by the stack length
Keep parallel devices at unit width for the single-device worst case
Sum nMOS and pMOS widths to get each input's capacitance

label: Compound gates by longest path
subgoals: Find the longest series path through each transistor
Set the width to that path length times the unit width
Compute each input's capacitance from its two transistor widths
